senses.gloss:
हय् हय् [cf. rt. 1. हि, in sense ‘to go’], cl.
1. P. हयति, जहाय, हयिष्यति, अहयीत्,
हयितुम्, to go, move, (in Naigh. II. 14. हयन्तात्
is enumerated among the गति-कर्माणः); to re-
vere, worship; to sound; to be weary.

हय हय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. हि, but connected
with rt. हय् above), a horse; a symbolical expression
for the number seven (that being the number of the
horses of the Sun, see सप्ताश्व); a man of a par-
ticular class; N. of Indra; of a Yādava king; the
Yak or Bos Grunniens; (in prosody) a foot of four
short syllables, proceleusmaticus; (आ), f. = हय-गन्-
धा below; (ई), f. a female horse, mare.
—हय-
कातरा or हय-कातरिका, f. a kind of plant or tree.
—हय-कोविद, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in horses.
—हय-गन्ध, अम्, n. a kind of medicinal salt,
= काच-लवण; (आ), f. the plant Physalis Flexuosa;
another plant (= अज-मोदा).
—हय-गर्दभि, इस्,
m. epithet of Śiva.
—हय-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘horse-
necked,’ N. of a form of Viṣṇu (manifested, accord-
ing to one legend, in order to recover the Veda
carried off by two Daityas called Madhu and Kaiṭa-
bha); N. of a Daitya (called ब्रह्म-वेद-प्र-
हर्तृ, as having seized and carried off the Vedas at
the dissolution of the universe caused by Brahmā's
sleep at the end of the past Kalpa; in order to re-
cover them Viṣṇu became incarnate as the Matsya
or fish, and slew Haya-grīva); N. of a poet; (आ), f.,
N. of Durgā.
—हयग्रीव-हन्, आ, m. ‘slayer of
Haya-grīva,’ Viṣṇu.
—हयङ्-कष, अस्, m. ‘im-
pelling horses,’ a driver, charioteer; epithet of Mātali
(charioteer of Indra).
—हय-ज्ञ, अस्, m. one who
understands the points of a horse, a horse-dealer, groom,
jockey.
—हयज्ञ-ता, f. knowledge of horses and
their management, horsemanship.
—हय-ज्ञान,
अम्, n. knowledge of horses.
—हय-तत्त्व-ज्ञ,
अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with the nature of horses.
—हय-द्विषत्, अन्, m. ‘hating horses,’ the buffalo.
—हय-निर्घोष, अस्, m. the noise or clatter of a
horse.
—हय-पुच्छ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a horse's tail;
(ई), f. the plant Māṣa-parṇī, q. v.
—हय-प्रिय,
अस्, m. ‘dear to horses,’ barley; (आ), f. = हय-गन्-
धा above; the Kharjūrī tree.
—हय-मार or
हय-मारक, अस्, m. ‘horse-killer,’ the fragrant
oleander (= कर-वीर).
—हय-मारण, अस्, m.
‘horse-killing,’ the sacred fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa.
—हय-मेध, अस्, m. the horse-sacrifice, (see
अश्व-मेध).
—हयमेध-याज्, ट्, m. one who
[]
performs the horse-sacrifice.
—हय-रूपिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, Ved. having the shape of a horse.
—हय-लीला-
वती, f., N. of a work (mentioned by Malli-nātha).
—हय-वाहन, अस्, m. epithet of Revanta (son
of the Sun); of Kuvera.
—हय-वाहन-शङ्कर,
अस्, m. red mountain-ebony or a particular tree (=
रक्त-काञ्चन).
—हय-शाला, f. a stable for horses.
—हय-शास्त्र, अम्, n. any treatise on horses, the
art or science of training and managing horses.
—हय-शिरस्, अस्, n. a horse's head; a mythical
monster (described as vomiting forth the fire of
Aurva's wrath, which was cast into the sea); (आस्), f.
‘having a horse's head,’ N. of a daughter of Vṛṣa-
parvan; of a wife of Kratu.
—हय-शीर्ष, अस्, m.
‘having a horse's head,’ a form of Viṣṇu.
—हय-
शीर्ष-पञ्चरात्र, N. of a work.
—हय-सङ्ग्र-
हण, अम्, n. the restraining or curbing of horses,
checking horses.
—हयाध्यक्ष (˚य-अध्˚), अस्,
m. a superintendent of horses, head-groom.
—हया-
नन्द (˚य-आन्˚), अस्, m. ‘horse's-joy,’ a kind of
bean, Phaseolus Mungo.
—हयायुर्-वेद (˚य-
आय्˚), अस्, m. the science of medicine applied to
horses, veterinary science.
—हयारि (˚य-अरि), इस्,
m. ‘horse-foe,’ the fragrant oleander, Nerium Odorum.
—हयारूढ (˚य-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on a
horse; (अस्), m. a horseman, rider.
—हयारोह (˚य-
आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on horseback, a rider; (अस्),
m. horsemanship, riding.
—हयाशना (˚य-अश्˚),
f. ‘horse-food,’ the gum olibanum tree.
—हयेष्ट
(˚य-इष्˚), अस्, m. ‘loved by horses,’ barley.
—ह-
योत्तम (˚य-उत्˚), अस्, m. ‘best of horses,’ a well-
bred or excellent horse (= आजानेय).

हयन, अस्, m. a year [cf. the more usual form
हायन]; (अम्), n. a covered carriage or palanquin,
(also read डयन, q. v.)

1. हायन, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (for 2. see col. 2),
quitting, leaving; passing away, (in this sense per-
haps to be connected with rt. 2. हा; cf. 2. हायन,
col. 2.)

हायन 2. हायन, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably
fr. हयन and connected with rt. 1. हि, but cf.
1. हायन at col. 1), a year, (at the end of an
adj. comp. the fem. ends in ई, cf. द्वि-ह्˚); (अस्), m.
a flame, ray; a sort of rice; epithet of Takman (so
called either from this disease lasting the whole year
or because it returns every year).
हायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, leaving, abandoning, neglecting.

हायस् हायस्, अस्, n., Ved. = 2. धायस्,
support, vigour, strength; [cf. सर्व-ह्˚.]
